observed_problem: The historical audit has distilled many Human Review defects into durable invariants, but Core v2 does not yet expose them as one concise stage/profile-aware prevention playbook that a new ChatGPT production session is required to apply. Without that mapping, deterministic defects can miss tooling protection and semantic/visual defects can depend on reviewer memory.
expected_behavior: Every material recurring Human Review defect family should have one explicit primary prevention/inspection owner chosen from DETERMINISTIC_TOOL_CHECK, CHATGPT_RESEARCH_REVIEW, CHATGPT_EDITORIAL_REVIEW, CHATGPT_VISUAL_REVIEW, HUMAN_ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW, HUMAN_PUBLICATION_PREVIEW, or LEGACY_ONLY/NOT_APPLICABLE. Only crisp deterministic recurrence needs executable regression protection; semantic and visual judgment remains agent/Human-owned as appropriate.
actual_behavior: The invariant/deep-audit corpus documents the relevant Issues, but production bootstrap does not yet require one compact checklist/matrix that tells ChatGPT which lessons apply at each stage and which items are handled by tools versus reasoning review.
production_workaround: Keep PR #310 draft while WU-012D creates the agent-first Issue Prevention Checklist. Do not add validators solely to convert qualitative review into machine PASS rows.

provenance.human_review_reference: User premise correction and ChatGPT-first pre-approval re-audit, 2026-08-22

improvement_action: Implement WU-012D: create a concise Issue Prevention Checklist/ownership matrix for production agents, route crisp failure classes to deterministic helpers, route semantic/visual concerns to required ChatGPT review, and preserve the two Human Gates without adding reviewer-memory-only requirements.
